description: Simplification Item to candidate-process mapping, authored by readiness-analysis directly from its findings (no dedicated Tool) as conversion-scoping's primary input. Client applicability explicitly remains unverified until conversion-scoping confirms it against the RBA/RSA catalog, per the plan's Artifact Contracts table.

candidate_process.description: Free-text candidate business process/area, before conversion-scoping resolves it against the RBA/RSA catalog.

applicability_verified.description: Always false when written by readiness-analysis. conversion-scoping flips this to true only after matching against the RBA/RSA catalog and the client's own process scope.
